9192: Kaiman is a human born in the Hole with an immunity towards magic. He has made it explicitly clear that "Kaiman" was not his actual name, but was given to him by Nikaido after he began suffering from amnesia.
16057: Nikaido is a companion to Kaiman, who both hunt Magic Users. She is the owner of a restaurant called the Hungry Bug in the Hole. There she serves primarily gyozas with a few slices of shiso, which Kaiman adores. Nikaido's gyozas are constantly declared as the best in the Hole.
16058: Shin is an elite Magic-User, a cleaner for En, and the partner and long-time friend of Noi. His magic allows him to cut people up without killing them. Shin is a tall man of muscular build, with short blonde hair, blue eyes, and pale skin.
16059: Noi is an elite Magic-User, and the partner and long-time friend of Shin. She works with him as a cleaner for En, who is her older cousin. Noi has pink-white hair and red eyes. She is the fourth tallest character in the series and is very muscular.
16060: Boss of the En family and is an elite Magic User. He is cousins with Noi and Kikurage's partner. He's also good friends with Chidaruma, who is the most powerful Devil.
16063: Ebisu is a young, androgynous and sullen looking woman who first appears in chapter three, donning a skull shaped mask. She is walking through the Hole, unable to summon a door back to the Magic Users' world due to the barrier between worlds currently in effect.
31212: Risu couldn't produce any magic smoke. Believing himself to be one of the many magically-impaired members of sorcerer society, he joined the CrossEyes organization to make a living.
32745: Vaux, more commonly known to everyone in Hole as "Doc", owns a hospital that treats Magic user victims. His job is morbid and gorey and he doesn't always manage to save his patients, but without him, many more residents of Hole would die.
36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
40923: Chota is an elite Magic-User, one of the "big brass" of The En Family, and the most avid fanatic of En. He is completely obsessed with En and ever-hopeful of being his partner.
40926: A doctor from the Hole who in the past helped Shin get to Magic Users world. He has a laboratory where he researches magic users and their magic. He is actually 64 years old and keeps his young appearance thanks to magic smoke he produced.
40955: A magic user who used to take care of Nikaido as a child and her friend Yakumo. He was a devil named Asu.
40985: Member of En's family, an assassin. His magic ability is becoming invisible whenever he wants.
42321: He's a cockroach, 2 years old, 268 cm tall. Became huge in size because of the rainwater where he lived in. Pretty much there for comedic effect, as well as part of Dr. Vaux's baseball team. His catch phrase is, "Shocking!".
68585: Thirteen is an ordinary human from Hole. He is friends with Bauks and has a crush on Nikaido.
79439: Fukuyama works at Tanba's pie shop. His magical abilities allow him to turn anything and anyone into meat pies.
79441: Tanba is the company president of a meat pie shop (also called "Tanba") in the magic user world. Fukuyama and Kirion are his employees, and Kaiman worked for him for a time.
79443: Chidaruma is leader of the Devils. He is friends with En and is very interested in Ai's tinkering with magical science.
79445: Kikurage (named after the Judas' Ear mushroom) is a devil animal who En adopted into his Family because she has the very rare magic of resurrection. As long as a sorcerer's devil tumor is intact, Kikurage can bring them back to life.
79491: Turkey is a member of the En Family. Her magic allows them to cook up living (though mute) copies of people from pictures or memories. The copies are drawn to the location of the originals, living or dead.
164745: Asuka is a former Tanba restaurant's employee and has an unrequited love for her boss. She wears a bat-shaped mask that covers her entire face, leaving only her mouth and eyes exposed, her hair is black and spiky and she wears clothes with cleavage and mice hanging from them.
190299: Baku was a Magic-User and one of two thugs that try to capture Noi and Shin and force them to become their partners along his companion Yaku. His magic was explosive in nature.
190300: The Acupuncturist is a Magic User who has the power to change people's faces.
190301: Tenjin was an Elite Magic-User and the very first member of the En Family.
208949: Yaku was a Magic-User and one of two thugs that tried to capture Noi and Shin and force them to become their partners along with his companion Baku. His specialty was tranquilizers and that might be his type of magic.
208950: Miyamoto was a member of the Cross-Eyes who knew Risu.
208951: Tanabe was a Magic-User and a lieutenant in the Cross-Eyes group.
239957: Kink is a human from Hole and the friend of Suss. He showed up for the baseball match against the Heiwa Clinic Sharks.
239958: Suss is a human from Hole and the brother of Dr. Vaux. He showed up for the baseball match against the Heiwa Clinic Sharks.
